text: Figure 9.64: Taxonomy of Cryptographic Object Interfaces Name: CryptoObject Technology: Native interface Usage: Public API Description: A common interface for all cryptographic objects recognizable by the CryptoProvider. GetCryptoPrimitiveId Return the CryptoPrimitiveId of this object. GetObjectId Return the object’s COIdentifier, which includes the object’s type and UID. GetPayloadSize Return actual size of the object’s payload. HasDependence Return the COIdentifier of the object that this object depends on. Operations: IsExportable Get the exportability attribute of the crypto object. ▽
